The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bb2a84e535643f76), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. statement: Given W > 0 and R0 > 0, there is a torsion-free principal congruence subgroup Γ0, normalized by σ, with the following properties. Let A0 be the union of all Γ0-translates of the labeled hyperplanes of D. (1) The arrangement A0 is locally finite. The hyperplanes meeting any ball of radius W have distinct labels and are carried to the corresponding subarrangement of D by a holomorphic isometry induced by a unitary map sending each prescribed translated normal to its prototype normal. (2) The injectivity radius of Γ0\B is greater than R0. (3) In the ball of radius R0 about o, the arrangement is exactly D restricted to that ball. The analogous assertion holds in every Γ0-translate of this ball. All these conclusions concerning the lifted arrangement remain valid on any subsequent finite cover of Γ0\B, provided one uses the full inverse image of the arrangement.
